commands: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin main >/dev/null; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; echo MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); adb shell pm path io.blueeye | grep '^package:'; adb shell wm size

set -euo pipefail; adb logcat -c; adb shell am force-stop io.blueeye; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/tmp/tracker-launch.txt 2>&1; sleep 2; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; echo PID=$PID; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-window.xml >/dev/null; adb shell cat /sdcard/tracker-window.xml | tr '>' '>\n' | head -n 120

set -euo pipefail; echo '--- PERMISSIONS ---'; adb shell dumpsys package io.blueeye | grep -E 'android.permission.(BLUETOOTH_SCAN|BLUETOOTH_CONNECT|ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION|ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION|POST_NOTIFICATIONS).*granted=' || true; echo '--- LOGCAT ---'; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID" | tail -n 160
